main_text.p: كريغوريوس ابو الفرج بن الحكيم الفاضل اهرون المتطبب الملطي Dixit Dominus noster, Pater Sanctus, eximius, doctrinâ & eruditione insignis, doctorum rex, excellentium excellentis-simus, temporum suorũ exemplar, sæculi Phænix, sapientum gloria. Doctor divinâ ope suffultus, Mar Gregorius Abul-Pharaj, filius excellenter sapientis, Ahronis medici Malatiensis: è quorũ verborum regione in margine, manu recen-tiori, appositum est, المشهور بادن قف النصراني i.e. qui vulgo notus est nomine Ebn Koph Chri-stiani. Nec minùs gloriosis elogiis (pro more Orientalium) ad alterius exemplaris calcem ornatur, scil. ابينا وسيدنا ملك العلما وتاج الفضلا محل المشكلات الخفية من الكلمات الالهية رئيس روسا الامة النصرانية وخلاصة فضار الملة المعقوبية مار غريغوريوس السين الى المغربان وحين العصر وفريد الزمان Pater & Dominus nostri, rex doctorum, & corona virorum virtu-te præstantium, dubiorum in Theologicis occulto-rum ἀποκρύφων[?] Christianorum Princeps primarius, Sectæ Iacobiticæ {*}medulla, Mar Gregorius, Do-minus, Pater, unicum ævi decus, & sæculi Phæ-nix. his addi possunt, è titulo Grammaticæ Syriacæ* Ad verb. pura substantia,

page.notes: The Arabic lines are copied as printed; individual Arabic words that are hard to read may be wrong. The Greek word after "occulto-rum" is uncertain and marked [?]. The asterisk in the text ("*medulla") refers to the right-margin note "Ad verb. pura substantia,". The "* 2" at the foot is a signature mark, not a page number.
